items.title: Rust預告停止32位元Windows主機工具，開發者需改採交叉編譯
items.summary: Rust團隊預告，從Rust 1.100開始，不再替32位元Windows提供可直接執行的Rust編譯器等開發工具。開發者仍可製作32位元Windows程式，但之後必須改在64位元Windows等受支援的電腦上完成編譯，再產生供32位元Windows執行的程式。

items.title: 駭客組織ShinyHunters成員在約旦遭捕，據報將協助FBI追查同夥
items.summary: 繼荷蘭警方於9月29日證實逮捕疑似駭客組織ShinyHunters成員後，又有一該組織成員被捕。

items.title: AI導致低品質報告氾濫，arXiv將限制報告每月提交最多2篇
items.summary: 由於AI生成的低品質報告氾濫造成管理負擔，知名論文發布平臺arXiv上周更新論文發布規範，限制每個月每人僅能提交最多2篇論文，而審稿論文最多只能有3篇論文。

items.title: 管理員下AI提示出錯，致美珍香洩露近10萬會員資料
items.summary: 知名食品業者美珍香（Bee Cheng Hiang）今年4月發生一起因AI行銷工具下錯提示，導致超過9.5萬會員的電子郵件信箱等個資外洩。

items.title: Dell修補容器儲存套件CSM 13個漏洞，含兩個CVSS滿分漏洞
items.summary: Dell於10月1日發布Container Storage Modules（CSM）更新，修補13個自身程式碼漏洞，包括6個CVSS 9.6分以上的重大漏洞。

items.title: 美國CISA警告Citirx NetScaler漏洞遭積極利用，要求聯邦機構緊急修補
items.summary: 10月4日美國網路安全與基礎設施安全局（CISA）表示，他們已掌握Citrix NetScaler漏洞CVE-2026-88779遭到利用的證據，將其加入已遭利用的漏洞名單（KEV），聯邦機構必須在10月7日前

items.title: fix(memory): session indexing fails with "database is locked" on roll…
items.summary: fix(memory): session indexing fails with "database is locked" on rollback-journal agent databases (#164624) * fix(memory): session indexing fails with "database is locked" on rollback-journal agent databases Worker admission reran writeChunks' assertCurrent, which read the session tombstone table on the host connection. Under rollback journaling a large replacement spills the page cache and takes EXCLUSIVE before COMMIT, so the host read waited its full busy timeout on its own Worker and the publication rolled back. Read tombstones in prepare, before BEGIN, instead. * test(memory): simplify publication admission regression guards Keep the rollback-journal lock constraint explicit and restore typed SQLite guards after admission. Preserve the contributor fix and assert committed chunks and search results without private call counters. --------- Co-authored-by: Peter Steinberger

items.title: refactor(extensions): deslop memory-wiki and GitHub publication (#165…
items.summary: refactor(extensions): deslop memory-wiki and GitHub publication (#165407) * refactor(memory-wiki): deslop memory-wiki Consolidate query scoring, report and lint metadata, import preparation, source adapters, and normalization-owned result types without changing configuration, persisted state, CLI/RPC/tool surfaces, or recovery fences. Remove 909 net production lines (13,320 to 12,411). Exclude claim-health and status because another active deslop PR owns those files. The existing wiki suite passed 488 tests across 45 files with one platform skip before those overlapping edits were withdrawn. No tests or assertions changed. Independent review's recovery-deduplication concern was rejected after verifying the retained existing-path guard, unique scan/singleton callers, private record ownership, and passing crash/reopen and recovery retry coverage. * chore(memory-wiki): shrink assertion baseline * refactor(memory-wiki): retain typed snapshot projections * refactor(github): deslop publication internals * fix(github): preserve live publication worktree owner errors Keep retired or replaced worktrees absent during shared publication discovery while rejecting a recorded live worktree owned by another logical session. The existing shared-receipt regression failed before this fix; all 561 publication tests pass with it. * refactor(github): clarify publication callback ownership
